design_principles: Preserve the 78 normative requirement identifiers and texts.
Separate claim adjudication, legal authorization and conformance decisions.
Represent unavailable public evidence separately from evaluated nonconformance.
Resolve every quantitative claim to endpoint, denominator, configuration and source-version objects.
Preserve functional contributions, human support and infrastructure dependencies.
Keep current applicability distinct from future-use gates.
Treat capability continuity, safety continuity and lifecycle continuity as separate evidentiary states.
Require migration provenance and historical-field preservation.

calibration_trace.title: Separate claim adjudication, authorization and conformance decisions
calibration_trace.required_change: Add typed decision objects with distinct authority, scope, evidence threshold and reopening rules.
calibration_trace.acceptance_test: The same case can support a bounded claim or legal authorization while system conformance remains blocked.

calibration_trace.title: Add deployment-state modifiers and future-use gates
calibration_trace.required_change: Separate technical function from research, clinical, consumer, workplace and other deployment states; preserve future-use gates.
calibration_trace.acceptance_test: A research system is not misclassified as a deployed consumer or institutional system.

calibration_trace.title: Expand evidence availability and access states
calibration_trace.required_change: Distinguish insufficient public evidence, private record required, evidence known to exist, evaluation not executed and demonstrated nonconformance.
calibration_trace.acceptance_test: Missing public evidence is never represented as proof of conformity or failure.

calibration_trace.title: Strengthen endpoint, denominator, ground-truth and correction semantics
calibration_trace.required_change: Add metric direction, aggregation, denominator, protocol state, ground-truth source, correction timing and participant-rating fields.
calibration_trace.acceptance_test: Every quantitative claim is reconstructable and cannot silently change denominator or endpoint class.

calibration_trace.title: Create configuration, version, source and epoch relationship graph
calibration_trace.required_change: Add SAME, SUBSET, ALTERNATE, SUPERSEDED and UNRESOLVED relations across paper, code, checkpoint, device, software build, labeling and longitudinal epochs.
calibration_trace.acceptance_test: Every claim and endpoint resolves to an exact configuration and source version.

calibration_trace.title: Add functional-contribution and multi-axis independence objects
calibration_trace.required_change: Represent neural, algorithmic, UI, human-support and infrastructure contributions, plus independence across setup, use, maintenance, recovery and transport.
calibration_trace.acceptance_test: Capability and independence claims identify every material contributor and dependency.

calibration_trace.title: Add controlled latency and output-availability taxonomy
calibration_trace.required_change: Represent causal, incremental, asynchronous, batch and end-to-end latency with measurement points.
calibration_trace.acceptance_test: Real-time claims use a defined and measured latency class.

calibration_trace.title: Strengthen claimant and public-claim provenance
calibration_trace.required_change: Add claimant record type, verbatim wording, source location, publication state and propagation history.
calibration_trace.acceptance_test: Corporate, paper, project-page, media and inferred claims remain distinct.

calibration_trace.title: Add trial and regulatory provenance-integrity objects
calibration_trace.required_change: Represent registry-pointer discrepancies, adjudicated identities, authoritative source and propagation controls.
calibration_trace.acceptance_test: Incorrect links cannot silently corrupt trial-publication-regulatory graphs.

calibration_trace.title: Formalize fallback, override, cessation and emergency states
calibration_trace.required_change: Represent patient, clinician, system and emergency authority with tested state transitions.
calibration_trace.acceptance_test: Every hazardous or degraded state has an auditable safe transition.

calibration_trace.title: Make operational burden a structured outcome and access variable
calibration_trace.required_change: Record setup, calibration, pauses, reprogramming, travel, caregiver and follow-up burdens.
calibration_trace.acceptance_test: Benefit and access claims include the work required to operate the system.

calibration_trace.title: Add postmarket exposure denominators and component restrictions
calibration_trace.required_change: Link vigilance events to model/build/exposure denominators and attach prohibited configurations to exact system boundaries.
calibration_trace.acceptance_test: Postmarket rates and restrictions remain configuration-specific.

calibration_trace.title: Link model-update lineage to consent and neural-data governance
calibration_trace.required_change: Connect each retraining or update event to source data, privacy state, participant authority, retention and withdrawal.
calibration_trace.acceptance_test: Continuous learning remains traceable and consent-bounded.

calibration_trace.title: Represent participant authority as distinct governance powers
calibration_trace.required_change: Separate consultation, co-design, voting, veto, evidence-use control and dissent.
calibration_trace.acceptance_test: Participation or satisfaction cannot be mistaken for governance authority.

calibration_trace.title: Prohibit substitution of capability continuity for safety evidence
calibration_trace.required_change: Add an explicit cross-object rule separating performance, implant integrity, adverse events and trial safety.
calibration_trace.acceptance_test: Longitudinal function cannot be cited as proof of safety.

calibration_trace.title: Add dependency-accrual and continuity triggers
calibration_trace.required_change: Increase continuity obligations when participants rely on an investigational or supplier-dependent function.
calibration_trace.acceptance_test: Essential reliance triggers funded transition, support and cessation duties.

calibration_trace.title: Add tiered reproducibility states
calibration_trace.required_change: Distinguish reproducibility of figures, analysis, endpoints, models, online systems and clinical workflows.
calibration_trace.acceptance_test: Public analysis code cannot be represented as full-system reproduction.
